title: Prove sharp no-edge total-image bounds for every pattern dimension (no κ)
body:
## Result and scope

**The sharp no-edge total-image bound is `floor(3k/2)` at every pattern dimension k.** This holds for any binary rank-one idempotent collection whose patterns are nonzero and whose pattern span contains no matrix unit. Completeness and an irreducible image-basis subcollection are not required. If the action on a nonzero joint image is irreducible, the bound is `floor((3k-1)/2)`.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b725be51349cce4e0a262c76233838992042dd62/research/no-edge-total-image-bound/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b725be51349cce4e0a262c76233838992042dd62/research/no-edge-total-image-bound/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b725be51349cce4e0a262c76233838992042dd62/research/no-edge-total-image-bound/verify.py) and [scope record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b725be51349cce4e0a262c76233838992042dd62/research/no-edge-total-image-bound/TASK.json). The proof shows that all pattern dependencies of an independent image subcollection are generated by disjoint circuits of at least three members. A coordinate-column argument treats the full diagonal-relation space at once. The all-width proof uses no finite classification step.

**At pattern dimension five, both the total and irreducible image maxima are seven.** This closes the upper-bound question in [PR #7281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7281); its existing seven-image construction supplies prior sharpness evidence. The new theorem also extends the dimension-three/four support bounds and applies when the irreducible basis extraction needed by [PR #7686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7686) is unavailable. It is consistent with the extraction counterexamples in [PR #7688](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7688).

**No new kappa**, paid BIT word, native operation or full invoice is supplied. The selected frontier and all five assumptions remain unchanged. Coordinate classification of all attaining dimension-five pools is still open. This completes the [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19705407).

## Evidence and reproduction

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.16 replay passed on macOS arm64. Complete image-basis censuses at widths three and four cover 224036 collections with at most three members. All 95046 collections with nonzero unit-free pattern spans pass the full diagonal-relation certificate, including disjoint active supports and the entire relation code.

All 2825 width-three pattern spaces are enumerated. Of these, 1330 are unit-free, 336 have empty pools and 595 have irreducible nonempty pools. Every complete pool satisfies both applicable bounds. Complete sharp pools for `1<=k<=12` cover 8178 nonzero patterns. Larger odd, even and mixed circuits, five equality fixtures with overlapping-support controls, and the prior seven-image witness also pass. Matrix-unit, non-idempotent and zero-pattern controls violate the bound outside its hypotheses.

Metadata, committed bytes, modes, source ancestry, eight-file export and archive integrity pass. A read-only optimized export replay passes without Git or a usable PATH; all nine payload/manifest hashes and modes stay unchanged. The finite checks corroborate the written theorem and are not its all-width argument.

With CPython 3.12 and its standard library, from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/no-edge-total-image-bound/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B -O research/no-edge-total-image-bound/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/no-edge-total-image-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/no-edge-total-image-bound --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers:

```text
PASS_NO_EDGE_TOTAL_IMAGE_BOUND
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44278633902/job/134713145346) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. Predecessor scientific replays, the selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Sources and credit

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. @CubeJerry supplied the intersecting diagonal-dependency method in [PR #6838](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6838), [exact proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f177c4f27e63dfa2e886033bb6a4e2dcd91f40b6/research/bit-zero-edge-image-bound/PROOF.md). @unpaidmoon supplied the triple/support analysis and dimension-four bound in [PR #7139](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7139), [exact proof](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/007869ccdc22ee591b5a88d99a35f02511bffbee/research/no-edge-dim4-image-at-most-six/PROOF.md), and the seven-image construction in [PR #7237](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7237) and [PR #7281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7281), [exact source](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0cd5324c41490b856d0e94daa8b011683fc153f6/research/no-edge-dim5-fresh-link/PROOF.md). Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the fiber lemma credited by those exact sources; a short proof is included here.

Ali Romman's [PR #7686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7686), [exact proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9da06cbe0b888293cbb249cb29eef0f37addaa4f/research/no-edge-image-basis-bound/PROOF.md), and [PR #7688](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7688), [exact proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d9aba79eaed566640353efcb0a27b0d5649f705a/research/no-edge-basis-extraction-failure/PROOF.md), supply the immediate scope boundary. Their [matrix/lift routines](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9da06cbe0b888293cbb249cb29eef0f37addaa4f/research/no-edge-image-basis-bound/verify.py) and [subspace routine](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d9aba79eaed566640353efcb0a27b0d5649f705a/research/no-edge-basis-extraction-failure/verify.py) are reused with credit. Earlier bounds, examples and normal-form classifications are not new here. New work is Apache-2.0; no predecessor package is needed at runtime.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Card `bit-new-register-model`, scope changed to this scalar structural theorem; the native construction gate is unmet. Refreshed open/closed PR and Discussion overlap and live handoffs identify the bounded predecessors and no competing general-bound claim. Sparse local and unpublished work remain coverage limits. The next classification can start from two relation triples plus one free member, or a triple plus a quad, instead of an unbounded search for a larger image.
